messages:
Mira Patel: Quick follow-up on the outage postmortem. Need to lock owners + hard dates for fixes, decide status page wording, and confirm RCA sharing policy for customers. Also propose a recurrence-review rule after repeat root causes.

Joel Park: I can take the TTL enforcement. Estimate 5 business days to implement + tests. Target 2026-04-03.

Sana Iqbal: I'll own autoscaling thresholds and a canary policy. 3 business days. Target 2026-03-31.

ops-bot: Created tasks: "Enforce cache TTL guard" -> Joel Park -> due 1992758400; "Adaptive autoscale + canary" -> Sana Iqbal -> due 1992614400.

Mira Patel: Thanks. For customer comms: CS prefers a short status page entry within 24h and a redacted RCA link. Full internal RCA remains internal; expanded sanitized RCA provided on request (Legal review/NDA if needed). Agree?

CS Bot: CS confirms: short status entry + redacted summary link reduces inbound tickets. Provide pre-approved email template too.

Mira Patel: Draft status blurb for review: 

"Incident: Elevated latency on hosted inference API
Status: Resolved
Summary: A deployment script inadvertently reset cache TTLs under burst traffic, increasing compute and latency for a subset of requests (~4% during the event). Mitigation: Reverted the change and applied an emergency guard.
Next steps: Implement TTL enforcement, update autoscaling, add rollout gating. A redacted RCA summary is available via the status page; full internal logs are not public."

Joel Park: Looks good. If metrics confirm ~4% we can include it; otherwise say "a small percentage".

Sana Iqbal: Also propose recurrence policy: if the same root cause occurs >2 times in 6 months, trigger a 30-day recurrence review and exec notification. Add to postmortem template.

Mira Patel: Agreed. Action recap: 1) Joel: TTL guard by 2026-04-03, 2) Sana: autoscale + canary by 2026-03-31, 3) Publish short status blurb once percent confirmed, 4) Add recurrence-review rule to postmortem process, 5) Draft redacted RCA and email template for CS by 2026-03-28. Checkpoint meeting 2026-04-06.

CS Bot: Noted. We'll prep the email template and review the redacted RCA draft when ready.

Mira Patel: Thanks all, I'll update the tracker and loop in Legal for sharing language.
